note: D279 (hand-maintained): pairs exact only inside a window of their file's VC6 symbol pad (co.cpp's CoSymbolPadType, sclient.cpp's SEND_SYMBOL_PAD; workflow.md 3.4). pairs_cmp.py reports their loss as 'pad-held', not as a loss: no landing sweeps or sets a pad. The coordinator sweeps both pads once at the handoff (auxpad.py sweep --lockfree, sendpad.py --lockfree); a pair still out of every window then gets an accepted-corrections.json entry.
